verdict.rationale: Vercel documents connecting a GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket repo so that every push deploys, with preview URLs per branch. It also states Next.js deploys with zero configuration, and community users describe its onboarding as 'simply code... and... go!'. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the 40+ other frameworks are auto-detected with no build settings (zero-config is stated only for Next.js), and no detail on how build commands and output settings are inferred.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
Deploy Next.js with zero configuration, or bring one of 40+ supported frameworks.
Connect your Git repository to deploy on every push, with automatic preview environments for testing changes before production.
Get started by importing a project, choosing a template, or using the Vercel CLI. Then, git push to deploy.
